decisions.reason: Selecting a new authoritative manuscript file changes which revision must be integrated, but it does not change the editorial objective or the two client-approved rewrites retained by this Requirement.
The source selects a manuscript file and says nothing about the paperback cover's content, design, deliverable, or unresolved production responsibility.
The selected manuscript revision does not alter the chosen chapter images or the criteria for reviewing their editorial fit.
The source does not change chapter-image inclusion, selection, placement, timing, or full-page treatment.
Choosing the manuscript file to use does not change the requested KDP upload guidance, included steps, or delivery mode.
The source identifies the authoritative manuscript file but does not revise or cancel the requirement to italicize the Mama's Hot Take text.
The source contains no copyright-page decision and does not alter its alignment, publisher attribution, email, or website requirements.
Selecting an authoritative manuscript file does not change the requested paperback-publishing, publication-readiness, or copyright guidance.
The source does not modify the requirements to avoid image distortion, cropping, or pixelation.
The selected manuscript file does not reinstate or otherwise change the prohibition on the literal newline artifact in the title.
The source does not change the decision to retain the existing paragraph spacing and page density for the current version.
The source selects a manuscript file but does not alter the Chapter 12 subtitle hierarchy, line treatment, punctuation, or capitalization requirements.
